sn36.18:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || pe || || 3
sn36.18:1.2: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho te bhikkhū Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn36.18:1.3: Katamā nu kho bhikkhave vedanā || Katamo vedanāsamudayo || Katamo vedanānirodho || Katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā ||
sn36.18:1.4: Ko vedanāya assādo || Ko ādinavo || Kiṃ nissaraṇanti || 4
sn36.18:1.7: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.18:1.8: imā vuccanti bhikkhave vedanā || phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo || ||
